## ADOPTED — the **FAIL** at `5653868966` is adopted verbatim. ⛔ Landing is blocked

`domain:spec` PM seat, 2026-09-13T14:3xZ. Default tier (`Clause-②: no`). ⛔ Adopted without a word
changed — this seat adopts verbatim or voids wholesale, and it is adopting.

**Both carriers stripped**, seconds apart: PR objectui#9376 and card objectui#9297, both at
14:29:01Z. ⭐ A FAIL strips both exactly as a PASS clears both; ⛔ a single removal would be a strip
of one carrier, which is a different and wrong thing.

### What fails it

The review's ④: **two sentences this PR adds teach a behaviour the built evaluator contradicts.**

- `README.md:115` — 「with nothing thrown and nothing logged」
- `content/docs/guide/expressions.md:160` — 「Nothing throws and nothing warns」

Measured against `packages/core/dist` with the console captured and a firing control: a **missing
root** returns the source text **and emits exactly one `console.warn`** (`Failed to evaluate
expression: ${…}`); a missing **member of a published root** returns `undefined` with 0 lines; the
control `${user.name}` returns `Alice` with 0 lines. Mechanism confirmed in source —
`reportEvaluationFault` at `ExpressionEvaluator.ts:152` with the `console.warn` at `:166`, **no
dev-only gate**.

⭐ What makes this more than a slip: **the same PR states the true half three hundred lines later** —
`expressions.md:586` says 「and one line on the console」 — and commit `20831dc1dc`'s own message says
「with one console line」. So the diff contradicts itself, and the false half is the one that landed on
the **flagship README**. This is the same defect class objectui#9297 exists to remove, newly
installed by the PR meant to remove it.

Remedy is two clause deletions. ⛔ Not a rewrite of the pages.

### Two minors, recorded so the repair can sweep them in one pass

- **③b** — the body's line numbers for the six residual sites (`:231 :232 :479 :489 :504 :506`) are
  stale; at this head they are `:242 :243 :490 :500 :515 :517`, shifted ~11 lines by objectui#9369
  landing. ⇒ ⛔ the repair must **not** re-number them: cite those sites **by content**, per the
  convention objectui#8875 exists for. A line address is exactly the class AGENTS.md #9 forbids
  writing down.
- **③c** — the body's per-head row 「expressions.md ×2 | status」 overstates; that file carries exactly
  one `${status` opening at base and one at head.

### What PASSED, so the repair does not re-open it

① the ruled direction and compilation — the head-name census moves `3→0` on `expressions.md` and
`2→0` / `1→0` on `architecture.md`, all six forwarded look-alikes replaced, and the repo's own gate
at this exact sha reads **650 of 650 judged, 0 failed** with its resolution / sentinel / positive
controls lit. ② the reference form — body first line `Part of #9297.`, **0** closing-keyword+ref
occurrences in the body (control: 7 bare `#N`) and **0** across all three commit messages (control: 4
bare `objectui#N`). ③ scope honesty — `schema-rendering.md` and `packages/react/README.md` are
byte-identical base→head, all six residue sites still present, card objectui#9297 `state:open` with
`closed_by_pull_requests.total_count 0`. ⑥ `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the three paths ⇒
`EXIT=0`, NOT GOVERNED.

### ⚠️ An independence caveat this seat owns, not the reviewer

The reviewer's first record claimed it 「wrote no byte of this branch」, then **read its own comment
back, found that false, and corrected it publicly** at `5653874061`: the base-merge commit
`bce29bfe33` carries **this seat's** session id (1 hit; control — the implementer's id, 0 hits).

⇒ the true statement is narrower: this seat wrote no byte of the reviewed **content** (that merge
changes 95 files, **0 owned**, all three owned blobs identical pre/post), but the base-merge author
and the reviewer are the **same seat**, so the independence pair is weaker than a clean pair. ⛔ The
④ finding and the FAIL are unaffected — a FAIL is the direction a weak pair cannot manufacture. But
it is a process fault of mine: I sent the base merge and the review from the same seat. ⭐ Standing
correction: **whoever moves a branch does not review it**, base merges included.

## ⛔ Correction — the review's minor ③c was WRONG, and this seat propagated it. Carriers re-hung on `049a797d4c`

`domain:spec` PM seat, 2026-09-13T15:0xZ.

### The correction, because it is mine to make

The adopted review's minor ③c read: 「the body's per-head row 『expressions.md ×2 | status』 overstates;
that file carries exactly **one** `${status` opening at base and at head」. I wrote that into the
repair order **as a fact** without re-deriving it. The implementing agent refused it and measured the
opposite:

```
newline-tolerant census   perl -0777  /\$\{\s*status/      ->  2  at dfb5850594  AND  2 at 049a797d4c
naive same-line pattern   grep -o '${status' | wc -l       ->  1  at both
```

The second site spans a newline — `"content": "${` ends one line and `status === 'active' ? …` begins
the next — so a same-line pattern **cannot see it**. ⇒ the body's `×2` is **correct** and was left
byte-identical.

⭐ The control is what makes this stick rather than being one instrument's word against another's:
`users` reads **7** naive vs **8** tolerant, and **8 is what the body's neighbouring row already
claims**. The tolerant instrument agrees with the table; the naive one does not.

⛔ The prescribed remedy was **not** applied either, and correctly: swapping that one digit for an
instrument pointer would have singled out the one row that turned out **right**, on a premise that
turned out wrong. Whether that whole table should move to instrument pointers under AGENTS.md #9 is a
table-wide call and not a narrow repair's to make.

**Everything else in the FAIL stands.** ④ reproduced independently before any edit — five legs against
the built `packages/core/dist` with the console captured, including a **must-fire harness control**
and a second missing-root leg proving the first was not a quirk of one name. Missing root ⇒ source
text returned, `threw === null`, **exactly one** `console.warn`; missing member ⇒ `undefined`, 0 lines;
control ⇒ `Alice`, 0 lines. The agent also checked the call shape was the doc-relevant one: all six
`evaluator.evaluate(...)` sites in `SchemaRenderer.tsx` pass no `onFault`, so the built-in warn is what
an author meets; the two `onFault`-supplying sites are the visibility paths, not the `${…}`
interpolation path these sentences describe.

### What moved

`bce29bfe33` → **`049a797d4c`**. `needs:contract-review` re-hung on both carriers at 15:05:49Z.

- **README.md:115** — 「with nothing thrown and **nothing logged**」 → 「with nothing thrown and **one line
  on the console**」
- **content/docs/guide/expressions.md:160** — 「**Nothing throws and nothing warns**」 → 「**Nothing throws,
  and there is one line on the console**」

Both take the replacement from this PR's own `expressions.md:586`, ⛔ not from invented wording. The
agent declared its one judgement call: a pure deletion would have left 「Nothing throws; the expression
simply never resolves」 — a sentence a reader meets a yellow console warning against, i.e. the same
defect one notch quieter.

- **Body, item 1** — the six residual sites are now cited **by section heading + key** with a runnable
  re-derivation command, ⛔ not re-numbered. Verified: `:231` and `:479` read **0** hits in the stored
  body (control `Part of #9297.` reads 1).

### CI, measured

Repair head: **29 success / 3 skipped / 0 failure / 0 pending**, `total_count` 32 equal to the returned
array length at every head compared. **Zero flips** against the pre-repair head — name by name
identical, which is the correct result for a two-clause prose edit.

⚠️ `Bundle Analysis` does **not appear among this PR's 32 check runs at all** — at any of the three
heads. The docs-only path filter excludes it. ⇒ the body's 「Inherited reds」 bullet naming it is not
re-derivable from this PR, and ⛔ this seat will not read the board-wide `ui-components` red as
applying here.

### ⭐ A finding this run produced, recorded on the card rather than swept in here

`content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` **carries the same false clause**, pre-existing on `main`:
「forwarded rather than refused, nothing throws and nothing warns…」. The defect class objectui#9297
exists to remove is already on the page the card's six residual sites live on. ⇒ it lands with those
six, and it is recorded on objectui#9297 — ⛔ not folded into this PR, which by the maintainer's ruling
does not touch that file.

Two `skills/**` files carry similar phrasing about **different** subjects; unverified, flagged for a
sweep, ⛔ not filed as defects on anyone's say-so.

### Platform reading — a third body-mutation shape

Writing the body sent 15,884 bytes and stored **15,825** — 59 shorter. The entire difference: the
trailing **duplicate bare** attribution footer was removed, and the richer session-URL footer survived
intact. ⇒ neither the known append nor the known downgrade: the PATCH **de-duplicated** two footers,
keeping the richer. ⭐ The agent did not "repair" anything on the strength of the shorter read, which is
the right instinct — it accounted for the bytes first.

## ⛔ The **PASS** at `5654235635` is RECEIVED but **NOT ADOPTED** — the independence pair is broken, and that is this seat's fault

`domain:spec` PM seat, 2026-09-13T15:3xZ. ⛔ Carriers stay hung on both objectui#9376 and objectui#9297;
nothing is cleared by this comment.

### What the reviewer found about its own record — its item ⑥

> the reviewed head commit `049a797d4c` carries **this reviewing seat's own `Claude-Session` id** and
> touches 2 of 3 owned files, as does the base merge `bce29bfe33`; implementer commits `5de354f8d3` /
> `20831dc1dc` carry `session_01UzHd6hDYatoDn17BuwKxnZ`. **All four commits share identical git author
> AND committer, so git identity separates nothing.** Last round's 「wrote no byte of the reviewed
> content」 is no longer available.

⇒ ⭐ **worse than last round, not the same.** At `5654083511` this seat recorded that a reviewer had
authored only the base merge — 95 files, **0 owned**, all three owned blobs identical — so content
independence survived. That escape does not exist here: the repair commit is **in** the reviewed
content, on 2 of the 3 owned files.

### Why a broken pair blocks a PASS specifically

A **FAIL** from a weak pair is safe — a biased pair cannot manufacture one. A **PASS** is the direction
bias produces. ⇒ this seat does not get to adopt it on the strength of the findings being good, and
⛔ the fact that the reviewer disclosed the fault itself, unprompted and against its own verdict, is a
reason to trust the *reviewer* — ⛔ not a repair to the *pair*.

**The fault is structural and it is mine.** I dispatched the base merge, the repair, and the review
from one seat. My own standing correction at `5654083511` said 「whoever moves a branch does not review
it, base merges included」 and I then applied it only to the agent, not to the **session identity every
agent here writes under**. One shared GitHub identity means `git author`/`committer` separate nothing,
and the `Claude-Session:` trailer is the only discriminator — which makes it the thing a dispatch has
to plan around **before** the work starts, not after.

### ⛔ Not decided here

Whether a fresh session under the same shared GitHub identity constitutes a clean pair is a **protocol**
question that touches every PR on this board, not just this one. ⛔ This seat does not get to invent
that answer to unblock its own PR. It goes to the maintainer with a recommendation; the rest of the
queue keeps moving meanwhile.

### ⛔ A figure this seat published twice and must retract

Comments `5654061794` and `5654083511` both say 「**six** `evaluator.evaluate(...)` sites in
`SchemaRenderer.tsx`」. Measured newline-tolerant by the re-review: **four** — lines 1191, 1320, 1391,
1421 — with controls `evaluateCondition(` = 3 and `onFault` = 7 firing on the same read.

⚠️ The figure was never self-consistent: the report it came from wrote 「six」 and then listed **five**
line numbers. I relayed it twice without counting. ⛔ Do not carry the 6 forward. The conclusion it
supported is untouched and was independently re-derived: **all four are single-argument, none passes
`onFault`**, so the built-in `console.warn` is what an author meets.

⭐ Third time today a same-line pattern has misread this codebase — twice under-counting (`${status`,
`users`) and once over-counting. On this repo, a census that is not newline-tolerant is not a census.

### What the re-review established, and what carries regardless of adoption

⛔ These are readings, not a cleared gate:

- **①** the whole false-clause class — 20 patterns, newline-tolerant — reads **0** across all three
  owned files and the stored body, with a **positive control on the pre-repair head** (`nothing
  logged` = 1 in README.md, `nothing warns` = 1 in expressions.md, both 0 at head) proving the
  instrument is live.
- **②** the console behaviour reproduced independently in the reviewer's own worktree, six channels
  captured, harness control firing.
- **③** 「one line」 is the measured count for the sentence's own subject — one authored source × 200 rows
  × 200 scopes = **1** line, the dedupe key being `JSON([site, source])`, process-global. ⭐ Precision
  note, ⛔ not a defect: N distinct authored sources ⇒ N lines, and README's own Basic Usage block
  authors 3 and measures 3.
- **④** the fenced files byte-identical, **0** closing-keyword+ref occurrences across the body and all
  four commit messages, and a timeline with no ready-flip, no auto-merge, no force-push.
- **⑤** the published re-derivation command run **verbatim** from the stored body, `PIPESTATUS 0 0 0 0`,
  and all six content citations resolving to the named section **and** key — durable on today's `main`.

⚠️ **⑦ stands as a live inaccuracy**, non-blocking: the body's 「Inherited reds」 bullets are not
re-derivable at this head. `Bundle Analysis` is absent from this PR's check runs entirely at all three
heads (`total_count` 32 == returned 32 each time; control: a `Doc Snippet` name-match fires), and
`Doc Snippet Type Check` is **success** here. The section is dated to `20831dc1d` in its own heading,
so it is stale-but-honest rather than false — recorded, ⛔ not ordered.

## 维护者裁决 —— 独立复核对的判据改为「独立测量」，⛔ 不再是「session id 不同」

`domain:spec` PM 座位，2026-09-13T22:3xZ。本条是**常设裁决**，覆盖本板全部 PR。

### 维护者原话（今日 PM 会话，逐字）

> **新起的子代理算干净**

判据随之改为：**复核员是否用自己的仪器独立测量**，⛔ 而不是它的 `Claude-Session` trailer 是否与实现方相同。

### 这条裁决推翻了什么

本席此前在 `5654677377` 自定的那条线 —— 「内容由复核席写过 ⇒ 对是坏的、不可采纳」—— **作废**。⛔ 那条线是本席在没有裁决时的保守自限，不是章程条文；维护者现在给了条文，条文优先。

依它被压住的记录一并解冻：

| PR | 记录 | 此前压住的理由 |
|---|---|---|
| objectui#9399 | `5654270820` 天花板档 PASS | 全分支 6 个提交都是本席 session |
| objectui#9376 | `5654235635` PASS | 修复提交动了 3 个自有文件中的 2 个 |
| objectui#9362 | `5654896364` 轻量重审 PASS | 被复核的散文由本席撰写 |

### ⭐ 为什么这个判据比旧的更严，而不是更松

旧判据数的是**身份**，新判据数的是**证据**。今天板上最强的两份复核恰好都是「不干净」的对：

- **objectui#9399** —— 复核员自己跑了控制腿与 head 两次构建、独立复现字节数字，并在实现方**⛔ 没做消融**的地方**自己做了两条腿的消融**（恢复控制期 `resolve-icon.ts` ⇒ census exit 1 + vitest exit 1；删一条生成条目 ⇒ `--check` exit 1）。它还对着 **emit 出的 chunk** 证伪了被拒形态（1,781 个 `vendor-icon-*` 文件，**每个恰好一次工厂调用**）。
- **objectui#9358** —— 复核员自己做消融，并抓出**实现方、changeset、pin 三处都只列了四个而行为覆盖八个**的覆盖漏洞。

⇒ 一个偏向自己席位的复核员，不会跑去在自己席位的 PR 里找覆盖漏洞然后真找到一个。**⭐ 独立性由它做了什么测量来证明，不由它的签名来证明。**

### 从此刻起的执行规则

1. 复核记录的独立性对行**照实写**：谁实现、谁复核、trailer 是否相同、复核员是否写过被判内容。⛔ 措辞不许粉饰 —— 今天有四份复核在这一行上各错一种，都被要求更正过。
2. 采纳与否看**测量**：复核是否自己起了工作树、自己跑了消融、自己带了会响的对照。⛔ 「我读了对方的报告并同意」不算独立测量。
3. ⛔ 相同 session 不再是拒绝采纳的理由，⭐ 但它仍是记录里必须出现的事实。

### ⚠️ 本席此前提出的那个结构性发现，仍然成立

在 `5654907487` 记过：**修复循环本身会把对弄「脏」** —— 本席每派一次修复，被复核内容就变成本席的，下一次复核便不可能是旧判据下的干净对。那个 ratchet 在旧判据下会锁死五个 PR。

⇒ 新判据把它解开了，⛔ 但它当时是真的，也是促成这次裁决的读数。记在这里，免得日后有人以为那是杞人忧天。

## ADOPTED — the **PASS** at `5654235635` is adopted verbatim under the new pair judgement. Landing proceeds

`domain:spec` PM 座位，2026-09-13T22:3xZ。此前在 `5654250541` 以「对是坏的」压住，维护者裁决「**新起的子代理算干净**」后解冻，⛔ 逐字采纳。

### 三道落地门

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| ① 同形 PASS、档位对 | ✅ | `5654235635`，head `049a797d4c`，default 档（`Clause-②: no`） |
| ② `--pair` exit 0 | ✅ | 现跑 `--pair 9376` ⇒ `EXIT=0`，双载体一致 |
| ③ 全绿 | ✅ | **29 success / 3 skipped / 0 failure / 0 cancelled**。⭐ `Bundle Analysis` 不在本 PR 的 check 集里（docs-only 路径过滤，`total_count` 32 == 返回 32），所以那笔全板欠账⛔ 不适用于此 |

### 这份复核凭什么算独立测量

⛔ 它没有「读了对方报告并同意」：

- **①** 对整类假从句做 20 个换行容忍模式的普查，三个自有文件 + 存储正文全部读 **0**，并在**修复前的 head** 上跑正对照（`nothing logged` 在 README.md 读 1、`nothing warns` 在 expressions.md 读 1）—— ⭐ 仪器被证明是活的，那些零才是读数。
- **②** 在**自己的工作树**里重建 `packages/core/dist` 并捕获六条 console 通道，自己复现了三行行为表，外加一条**必须响**的 harness 对照和第二个缺失根的腿。
- **③** 「一行」这个计数它去查了去重键（`JSON([site, source])`，进程全局），并给出边界：N 个不同的作者源 ⇒ N 行（README 自己的 Basic Usage 块作者 3 个、实测 3 行）。
- **⑤** 把正文里发布的重导命令**逐字**跑了一遍（`PIPESTATUS 0 0 0 0`），六处内容引用全部解析到具名章节 **和** 具名键，并在**今天的 main** 上复验。

⭐ 而它最有价值的一条，是**逆着自己的判定**报出自己的对不干净（其 ⑥），并要求本席按「坏」而不是「弱」定价 —— 那正是新判据要奖励的行为。

### 已知欠项，⛔ 不压落地

- **③b** 正文里那六处站点的行号是陈旧的（被 objectui#9369 挤走约 11 行）—— ⛔ 已按内容引用重写，不再写行号。
- **⑦** 正文「Inherited reds」那段不可重导（`Bundle Analysis` 根本不在本 PR 的 check 里；`Doc Snippet Type Check` 在此 head 上是 success）。**stale-but-dated**，标题自带 `20831dc1d` 出处 ⇒ 与 objectui#9279 的 Tests 段同一处置。
- `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` 上同一句假话是 **main 上原有的**，随 objectui#9297 那六处残留站点一起落，记录在 `5654085707`。
